body.label: Target
body.html: Self or one willing ally within 3 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Trigger: An Action or Reaction would push or pull the target. Response (unopposed): Reduce that movement by 2 units and grant +1 Fortitude against the triggering Action.

surges.html: The target may move 1 unit toward another willing creature after the Action.
Reduce the Action's Damage to the target by 1.
